items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued October 5 at 2:51PM AKDT until October 9 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...High surf expected. Water levels of 2 to 4 feet above the
normal high tide line, peaking during high tide.

* WHERE...Shishmaref.

* WHEN...From 10 AM Thursday to 4 AM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Localized beach erosion may occur.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A low in the Western Bering Sea will send a
front moving East in the coast, resulting in south to southeast
winds ramping up Thursday morning through Friday, before
diminishing through Saturday. Sea levels will remain elevated
through Fri

items.headline: High Wind Watch issued October 5 at 2:17PM AKDT until October 9 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 60 mph
possible.

* WHERE...St Lawrence Island.

* WHEN...From late Wednesday night through late Thursday night.

* IMPACTS...High winds may damage property and cause power outages.
Travel could be difficult, especially for high profile vehicles.
items.instruction: Monitor the latest forecasts and warnings for updates.

items.headline: High Wind Watch issued October 5 at 2:17PM AKDT until October 9 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 60 mph
possible.

* WHERE...Bering Strait Coast, Interior Seward Peninsula, Shishmaref,
and Southern Seward Peninsula Coast.

* WHEN...From Thursday morning through late Thursday night.

* IMPACTS...High winds may move loose debris, damage property and
cause power outages. Travel could be difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 5 at 1:09PM AKDT until October 5 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* WHERE...Municipality of Skagway.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
